name: Enteric Fever and Non Typhoidal Salmonella

reference.source: Ananthanarayan and Paniker's Textbook of Microbiology (topic map; text rewritten, no verbatim copy)
clinicalPearls: Step ladder fever with rose spots: typhoid
Blood week one, Widal rising week two
reference.pathophysiology: Vi capsule blocks complement lysis while intracellular survival in macrophages seeds Peyer patches; ulcerating lymphoid hyperplasia thins ileal walls into perforation, and endotoxin sustains stepwise fever with myocardial depression slowing pulse.
additionalDifferentials: Enteric fever versus malaria by rose spots and bradycardia
Typhi versus NTS by systemic versus gut limited disease
Widal versus Tubex by timing and titre rise
additionalInvestigations: Blood culture week one with marrow when treated
Paired Widal titres with TyphiDot IgM
Gallbladder imaging with stool Vi in carriers
